text: Shipped the Harbor Ledger invoicing service across **120 commits** with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.
Maintained zero broken builds on the Tidepool Notes CI pipeline while adding offline sync.
Wrote **~85 unit tests** covering the Quillmark markdown parser's table and footnote edge cases.
Added **48 in-repo assert checks** to guard the Lumen Board layout engine invariants.
Grew the Orchard Maps frontend to **12,000 LOC** of TypeScript and React.
Authored **9 Flyway migrations** to evolve the Harbor Ledger schema without downtime.
Refactored **34 source files** to move the Quillmark renderer onto a plugin interface.
Designed **22 REST endpoints** for the Harbor Ledger billing API with idempotent retries.
Implemented **12 pricing strategy classes** behind a common interface, letting analysts swap models at runtime.
Integrated **3 payment providers** behind a single adapter, cutting checkout failures by **18%**.
Built a two-queue retry model for **8 command types** in the Lumen Board sync worker.
Rendered **WebGL** tiles in Orchard Maps at **16ms** per frame on mid-range laptops.
Cut median search latency from **420ms** to **95ms** by adding a trigram index in PostgreSQL.
Deployed the Tidepool Notes API to **3 regions** on Fly.io with health-checked failover.
Built an event-sourced ledger for Harbor Ledger in Kotlin. This architecture enabled rapid onboarding of new payment flows.
Added contract tests between the Quillmark parser and renderer. This commitment to quality ensured stable releases.
Hardened Lumen Board session handling with rotating refresh tokens. This ensured robust protection against replay attacks.
Migrated Orchard Maps from Webpack to Vite. Build times dropped by **70%**. Developers shipped features faster.
Introduced feature flags for Tidepool Notes releases. These changes significantly reduced release risk.
Rebuilt the Orchard Maps dashboard in Next.js with server components, e.g. streaming the tile index.
Upgraded Lumen Board from Spring Boot v3.1 to v5.4 and replaced blocking I/O with virtual threads.
Benchmarked Postgres vs. SQLite for Tidepool Notes offline storage. Chose SQLite for its single-file sync model.
Wrote a Node.js CLI that seeds demo data, i.e. accounts, invoices and refunds, for Harbor Ledger previews.
Led weekly design reviews for the Quillmark editor and wrote the decision log the team still uses.
Profiled the Orchard Maps tile server and removed an N+1 query that dominated cold-start time.
